### Fixed
- **The atenet router reaches the worker pods on 8443** (giantswarm/agent-platform#383): `substrate-atenet-router` allowed the router's egress to the worker pods on 443 only, but the router tunnels a turn's A2A request to the actor through the worker's mTLS CONNECT listener on 8443 (ateom `--atunnel-connect-listen-address :8443`), so under Cilium's default-deny every turn on a fleet installation failed with `upstream call failed: Connect: deadline has elapsed` — graveler's cut-over (giantswarm/giantswarm#37745) needed a hand-applied bridge policy. The policy now allows 443 and 8443; `make verify-kagent-netpol` asserts both. **Installations act**: none — the release rolls through the connectivity range; graveler's bridge policy `substrate-atenet-router-connect-cutover-bridge` is removed once it is live there.
